category_rationales.architecture: Clean 5-package acyclic Spring Boot layering (`api` -> `service` -> `domain` + `client` + `config`) with 0 circular dependencies, constructor DI, bounded HTTP timeouts, and Spring-free domain models, tempered by in-memory `ConcurrentHashMap` storage, missing `@RestControllerAdvice` `ProblemDetail` mapping, and absent `/actuator/health` probes.
category_rationales.code_quality: Concise 7-file / 180-LOC Java 21 codebase with 100.0% import hygiene, immutable `record` value objects, SLF4J structured logging, and interrupt restoration, held back by a check-then-act race condition on `ConcurrentHashMap` in `InventoryService.reserveStock` and manual JSON concatenation in `SupplierRestClient`.
category_rationales.typing: 100.0% generic type parameterization (`Optional<StockItem>`, `ResponseEntity<StockItem>`, `Map<String, StockItem>`), explicit `@Override`, and zero raw types or unchecked casts, with minor room to add `@Validated` Bean Validation annotations on `SupplierProperties`.
category_rationales.testing: Hermetic `--network=none` container JUnit 5 execution passes 2/2 tests in 10.46s (100.0% JaCoCo coverage in `ReorderPolicy` and `SupplierProperties`), but overall measured coverage is 62.7% line / 50.0% branch due to unexecuted `SupplierRestClient.requestRestock` (30.4% line / 0.0% branch), untested `GET /{sku}`, and missing `assertThrows` / MockMvc tests.
category_rationales.dependencies: Pinned Java 21 Maven coordinates, weekly Dependabot updates (`maven` + `github-actions`), and SHA-pinned GitHub Actions (`contents: read`), offset by outdated `spring-boot-starter-parent:3.3.4`, a 4-line `mvnw` pass-through stub, abbreviated 3-line `LICENSE`, and omitted `spring-boot-starter-actuator` / `jacoco-maven-plugin`.
category_rationales.security: Zero hardcoded/committed secrets (SEC-03), zero dangerous CWE code sinks (SEC-04), non-root (UID 10001) loopback-bound container (SEC-02, 1 LOW DS-0026), and 0 critical/high live HTTP DAST findings across 16 probes in .pni/pentests/examples/java/api_spring_clean (12 passed, confirming 400 validation and XSS/SQLi/traversal safety), weighed down by 8 CRITICAL and 29 HIGH Maven transitive CVEs in Spring Boot 3.3.4 (Tomcat 10.1.30, Spring WebMVC 6.1.13, Jackson 2.17.2), 5 HIGH Ubuntu 22.04 OS CVEs, live-verified unauthenticated POST /api/v1/items/{sku}/reserve reaching InventoryService.reserveStock() (CWE-306) and uncaught IllegalArgumentException HTTP 500 (CWE-755), missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (CWE-693), and manual JSON string concatenation.
category_rationales.documentation: 100.0% Javadoc coverage across all 7 classes and 16 callables with 0 signature mismatches alongside `SECURITY.md` and a Diataxis-aligned `README.md`, lacking only JDK 21/Docker prerequisites, `default-reorder-batch` documentation, and sample HTTP payloads.

structure_map.boundary_assessment: Dependency graph is a strict acyclic DAG (0 circular dependencies, 0 upward boundary violations). Domain types (`StockItem`, `ReorderPolicy`) and configuration (`SupplierProperties`) have zero inward coupling to web or client transport layers; only minor DTO coupling exists where `InventoryController` serializes `StockItem` directly.

execution_flows.name: SKU Stock Lookup Flow
steps: InventoryService.findBySku(sku) looks up StockItem in ConcurrentHashMap<String, StockItem> inventoryStore.
Optional<StockItem> maps to HTTP 200 OK JSON ResponseEntity<StockItem> when present or HTTP 404 Not Found when absent.

execution_flows.name: Stock Reservation & Conditional Supplier Restock Flow
steps: InventoryController.reserveItem(sku, quantity) validates @RequestParam @Min(1) int quantity and delegates to InventoryService.reserveStock(sku, quantity).

InventoryService.reserveStock fetches existing StockItem from inventoryStore (throwing IllegalArgumentException if unknown) and calls StockItem.withAdditionalReservation(quantity, Instant.now()) (throwing IllegalStateException if quantity > availableUnits).
InventoryService writes the new immutable StockItem snapshot back to inventoryStore and computes ReorderPolicy.recommendedOrderQuantity(updated, properties.defaultReorderBatch()).

When restockQty > 0 (availableUnits <= reorderPoint), SupplierRestClient.requestRestock(sku, restockQty) sends a bounded-timeout HTTP POST {baseUrl}/v1/restock request and logs the outcome via SLF4J before returning HTTP 200 OK with the updated StockItem.

state_and_storage: In-memory ConcurrentHashMap<String, StockItem> (InventoryService.inventoryStore) storing immutable StockItem snapshots keyed by SKU (ephemeral across JVM restarts; no external RDBMS/NoSQL repository configured).
Immutable externalized configuration record SupplierProperties bound from inventory.supplier.* properties / environment variables.
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Spring MVC servlet request threads share InventoryService; StockItem is an immutable Java 21 record, but InventoryService.reserveStock uses non-atomic get() + put() on ConcurrentHashMap. Domain invariants throw IllegalArgumentException / IllegalStateException (currently unmapped by @RestControllerAdvice, defaulting to HTTP 500), while SupplierRestClient catches IOException and InterruptedException (restoring Thread.currentThread().interrupt()) and degrades gracefully by returning false.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Supply-Chain CVEs, Container Misconfigs, Secrets, Dangerous Sinks & API Boundaries
audit_dimensions.summary: Trivy 0.69.3 and AST security evaluation confirm zero leaked secrets (SEC-03), zero dangerous CWE code sinks (SEC-04), and a non-root loopback-bound Dockerfile with only 1 LOW IaC notice (DS-0026 missing HEALTHCHECK, SEC-02), but fail SEC-01 due to 75 Maven application CVEs (8 CRITICAL, 29 HIGH, 28 MEDIUM, 10 LOW) in Spring Boot 3.3.4 transitive dependencies (Tomcat 10.1.30, Spring WebMVC 6.1.13, Jackson 2.17.2) alongside 453 Ubuntu 22.04 OS-layer CVEs (0 CRITICAL, 5 HIGH) and an unauthenticated POST /{sku}/reserve endpoint (SEC-05).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate JUnit Test Suite Completeness & Structure
audit_dimensions.summary: JUnit 5 test suite uses deterministic in-memory stubbing (StubSupplierClient) without live network dependencies, but comprises only 2 @Test methods across 2 flat-package test classes—leaving SupplierRestClient.requestRestock, InventoryController.getItem (200/404), MockMvc HTTP validation, and all domain/service exception branches untested.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Live HTTP Penetration Findings, Security Headers & Endpoint Defenses
audit_dimensions.summary: Dynamic containerized web penetration testing (.pni/pentests/examples/java/api_spring_clean, status=passed, 16 probes: 12 passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped, 0 critical/high findings in 7.19s against isolated loopback http://127.0.0.1:53369) confirmed strict @RequestParam int type validation (POST /api/v1/items/SKU-100/reserve?quantity=not-an-int -> 400) and zero reflected XSS, SQLi/stacktrace leakage, path traversal, or exposed .env/.git artifacts, while uncovering 3 live medium/low endpoint & header gaps: unauthenticated POST reservation reaching InventoryService.reserveStock() (CWE-306), uncaught IllegalArgumentException on unknown SKU returning HTTP 500 (CWE-755), and missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header (CWE-693).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Buildability, Offline Test Results, Measured Coverage & Startup Health
audit_dimensions.summary: Containerized runtime verification passed RV-01 (multi-stage Dockerfile build in 41.74s and Java 21 Maven harness build in 53.98s), RV-02 (2/2 JUnit 5 tests passed offline in 10.46s with --network=none), and RV-04 (InventoryApplication booted and bound tcp://127.0.0.1:18080 in 4.48s), while RV-03 measured 62.7% JaCoCo line coverage (42/67 lines) and 50.0% branch coverage—below the 80%/70% target due to SupplierRestClient (30.4% line / 0.0% branch) and InventoryController.getItem (62.5%).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate 12-Factor Config/Statelessness & SRE PRR Timeouts/Observability
audit_dimensions.summary: 12-Factor and SRE Production Readiness evaluation confirms centralized @ConfigurationProperties binding, zero scattered env lookups, SLF4J structured logging, and explicit HTTP connect/read timeouts in SupplierRestClient, while identifying three operational gaps: ephemeral in-memory ConcurrentHashMap stock storage, missing Spring Boot Actuator health/readiness probes, and unmapped domain exceptions returning HTTP 500.

audit_dimensions.title: Interpret Java AST Facts & Evaluate Quality/Generics/Imports/Security
audit_dimensions.summary: Java 21 AST analysis shows 100% Javadoc, generic typing, and import hygiene across 7 cohesive classes (180 LOC) with zero circular dependencies and pure domain isolation, while deep code inspection identifies an unauthenticated state-mutating POST endpoint (TODO security), manual JSON concatenation in SupplierRestClient, a check-then-act race condition on ConcurrentHashMap in InventoryService, and missing @Validated / ProblemDetail error mapping in Spring components.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Maven/Gradle Build, Supply Chain & Dependencies
audit_dimensions.summary: Maven build and supply-chain governance are well-structured with Java 21, Spring Boot 3.3.4 parent BOM, SHA-pinned GitHub Actions with contents:read permissions, Dependabot, SECURITY.md, non-root multi-stage Dockerfile, and Diataxis-aligned README headings, with minor gaps in the mvnw wrapper stub, abbreviated LICENSE text, missing Actuator/JaCoCo plugins in pom.xml, and concise README API/prerequisite details.

audit_dimensions.summary: OpenSSF Scorecard supply-chain posture is strong: GitHub Actions pins third-party actions to 40-char commit SHAs with contents:read permissions, Dependabot monitors maven and github-actions weekly, SECURITY.md and .dockerignore are present, and the multi-stage Dockerfile runs as non-root UID 10001 on loopback, with minor improvements needed for Maven Wrapper binary pinning and Dockerfile image digest / HEALTHCHECK hardening.

Explicit outbound HTTP timeouts (`connectTimeout` + per-request `timeout`) in `SupplierRestClient` prevent stalled upstream suppliers from exhausting servlet worker threads (`missing_io_timeouts = 0`).
Zero scattered `System.getenv` lookups (`scattered_env_access = 0`) and zero `System.out.println` calls (`unstructured_logging = 0`).
Deterministic offline isolation via `StubSupplierClient` and fixed `Instant.EPOCH` timestamps without flaky wall-clock or live network dependencies.
Clean JUnit Jupiter 5 assertions (`assertion_free_tests = []`) covering core reservation and `ReorderPolicy` replenishment thresholds.
Both repository multi-stage `Dockerfile` (`41.74s`) and Java 21 Maven test harness (`53.98s`) build cleanly from scratch with zero errors.

100.0% measured JaCoCo line coverage on `ReorderPolicy.java` (`100.0%` branch) and `SupplierProperties.java`.

Zero dangerous CWE code sinks (`CWE-78`, `CWE-89`, `CWE-94`, `CWE-502` all `0`, `SEC-04` PASS).

findings.evidence: `@PostMapping("/{sku}/reserve")` has `has_auth_hint=false` and line 57 notes `// TODO(security): Require OAuth2 JWT resource-server scope check before external ingress exposure.`
findings.description: State-mutating endpoint `POST /api/v1/items/{sku}/reserve` lacks authentication and scope authorization, allowing unauthenticated callers to deplete stock and trigger outbound supplier restock HTTP requests.

findings.evidence: `StubSupplierClient` overrides `requestRestock`, leaving `SupplierRestClient.requestRestock` (lines 44-63), `InventoryController.getItem` (lines 39-43), and all `IllegalArgumentException`/`IllegalStateException` paths without unit or MockMvc tests.
findings.description: Only 2 happy-path `@Test` methods exist across the repository; `SupplierRestClient` HTTP response/exception handling, `GET /api/v1/items/{sku}` (200/404), `@Min(1)` validation, and negative reservation invariants are untested.
findings.recommendation: Add `SupplierRestClientTest` using `com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer` (testing 200, 500, and timeout `IOException`), `@WebMvcTest(InventoryController.class)` MockMvc tests, and `Assertions.assertThrows` tests for unknown SKU and insufficient stock.

findings.evidence: `InventoryService.reserveStock` throws `IllegalArgumentException` (unknown SKU) and `IllegalStateException` (insufficient stock), with no `@RestControllerAdvice` / `@ExceptionHandler` in `api`.
findings.description: Domain exceptions (`IllegalArgumentException`, `IllegalStateException`) bubble out of `InventoryController.reserveItem` unmapped, causing Spring Boot to return HTTP 500 Internal Server Error instead of actionable 404 Not Found / 409 Conflict RFC 7807 `ProblemDetail` responses.
findings.recommendation: Add a `@RestControllerAdvice` mapping `IllegalArgumentException` to HTTP 404 and `IllegalStateException` to HTTP 409 using Spring 6 `ProblemDetail`.

findings.evidence: `@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "inventory.supplier") public record SupplierProperties(String baseUrl, int timeoutSeconds, int defaultReorderBatch)` lacks `@Validated` and field constraints.
findings.description: `SupplierProperties` omits `@Validated` and Jakarta Bean Validation constraints (`@NotBlank`, `@Positive`), allowing blank supplier URLs or invalid batch sizes to pass startup binding silently.
findings.recommendation: Annotate `SupplierProperties` with `@Validated` and apply `@NotBlank` to `baseUrl` and `@Positive` to `timeoutSeconds` and `defaultReorderBatch`.

findings.evidence: `StockItem existing = inventoryStore.get(sku); ... inventoryStore.put(sku, updated);`
findings.description: `InventoryService.reserveStock` performs a non-atomic `get` followed by `put` on `ConcurrentHashMap`, creating a race condition where concurrent reservations for the same SKU can overwrite each other and oversell stock.
findings.recommendation: Perform the reservation update atomically inside `inventoryStore.compute(sku, (k, existing) -> ...)` before evaluating `ReorderPolicy`.

findings.evidence: mvnw executes `exec mvn "$@"` without `.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties` distributionUrl/sha256sum.

findings.recommendation: Generate standard Maven Wrapper metadata (`mvn wrapper:wrapper -Dmaven=3.9.9`) with SHA-256 verification in `.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties` and invoke `./mvnw` in Dockerfile.

findings.evidence: `String body = "{\"sku\":\"" + sku + "\",\"quantity\":" + quantity + "}";`

action_plan.title: Enforce OAuth2 JWT authorization and SKU validation on reservation API
action_plan.action: Add `spring-boot-starter-oauth2-resource-server`, enforce `SCOPE_inventory:write` on `POST /api/v1/items/{sku}/reserve` via `SecurityFilterChain`, add `@Validated` to `InventoryController`, and constrain `@PathVariable @Pattern(regexp = "^[A-Z0-9-]{3,32}$") String sku`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Closes the unauthenticated stock reservation attack surface (`SEC-05`) and blocks malformed SKU inputs at the HTTP boundary.

action_plan.title: Upgrade Spring Boot BOM, Embedded Tomcat, and Jackson to remediate 8 CRITICAL / 29 HIGH CVEs
action_plan.action: Upgrade `spring-boot-starter-parent` in `pom.xml` from `3.3.4` to `>= 3.5.14` (or `4.0.6`), remove redundant child `<version>3.3.4</version>` overrides so BOM versions govern, and pin `<tomcat.version>10.1.58</tomcat.version>` and `<jackson-bom.version>2.18.11</jackson-bom.version>`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates all 8 CRITICAL and 29 HIGH Maven application CVEs in Tomcat, Spring WebMVC, and Jackson (`SEC-01`).

action_plan.title: Add RFC 7807 @RestControllerAdvice error mapping, @Validated config, and Actuator health probes
action_plan.action: Add `spring-boot-starter-actuator` (`management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health`), implement `@RestControllerAdvice` returning RFC 7807 `ProblemDetail` (`404` for unknown SKU, `409` for insufficient stock, `400` for constraint violations), and annotate `SupplierProperties` with `@Validated` (`@NotBlank`, `@Positive`).
action_plan.expected_impact: Provides Kubernetes-ready `/actuator/health` liveness/readiness probes, deterministic 4xx client error contracts, and fail-fast startup config validation.

action_plan.title: Eliminate JSON concatenation in SupplierRestClient and race condition in InventoryService
action_plan.action: Serialize a typed `RestockRequest` record with Jackson `ObjectMapper` in `SupplierRestClient.requestRestock`, and replace the `get`/`put` sequence in `InventoryService.reserveStock` with atomic `inventoryStore.compute(...)`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Prevents outbound JSON injection and guarantees linearizable stock reservations under concurrent HTTP load.

action_plan.title: Map Unknown SKU Exceptions to 404 ProblemDetail & Verify via .pni/pentests Suite
action_plan.action: Enforce OAuth2 JWT authentication on POST /api/v1/items/{sku}/reserve and translate IllegalArgumentException("Unknown SKU: ...") into HTTP 404 ProblemDetail so all test_app_probes.py checks pass with 401/403 and 404 instead of 500.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates live CWE-306 unauthenticated service execution and CWE-755 unhandled HTTP 500 responses.

action_plan.title: Refresh JRE base image to remediate 5 HIGH Ubuntu OS CVEs and resolve DS-0026
action_plan.action: Update `Dockerfile` runtime stage from `eclipse-temurin:21.0.4_7-jre-jammy` to a digest-pinned patched `eclipse-temurin:21-jre-noble` (or distroless Java 21) image with `apt-get upgrade -y` and add `HEALTHCHECK`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Resolves `libssl3`/`openssl` (`CVE-2026-45447`) and `gpgv` (`CVE-2025-68973`) HIGH OS vulnerabilities and clears Trivy `DS-0026`.

action_plan.title: Close JaCoCo line (62.7% -> >=85%) and branch (50.0% -> >=75%) coverage gaps
action_plan.action: Add local embedded `HttpServer` tests exercising `SupplierRestClient.requestRestock` (2xx, 5xx, timeout), `@WebMvcTest` tests for `InventoryController.getItem` (200/404), and `assertThrows` tests for lines 40/43 of `StockItem` and line 67 of `InventoryService`, enforced by `jacoco:check` in `pom.xml`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates untested production code paths and satisfies RV-03 (>=80% line, >=70% branch coverage).

action_plan.title: Expand JUnit 5 & MockMvc test suite across controller, HTTP client, and error branches
action_plan.action: Switch `pom.xml` to `spring-boot-starter-test` + `jacoco-maven-plugin` (>=80% gate), add `@WebMvcTest` tests for `GET /{sku}` (200/404) and `POST /{sku}/reserve` (`@Min(1)`), test `SupplierRestClient` against a local `HttpServer`, and add `assertThrows` tests for `StockItem` and `InventoryService`.

action_plan.title: Pin full Maven Wrapper distribution and complete Apache-2.0 LICENSE text
action_plan.action: Generate full Maven Wrapper scripts with `.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties` (`distributionSha256Sum`), switch `Dockerfile` build stage to `./mvnw -B package`, and populate full SPDX Apache-2.0 text in `LICENSE`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Guarantees identical Maven CLI versions across developer machines, CI, and container builds while ensuring complete open-source license compliance.

action_plan.title: Expand README with prerequisites, complete configuration reference, and curl examples
action_plan.action: Add JDK 21 / Maven 3.9 / Docker prerequisites, document `INVENTORY_SUPPLIER_DEFAULT_REORDER_BATCH`, and provide sample `StockItem` JSON responses and HTTP error status codes.

action_plan.title: Emit X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff Baseline Security Header
action_plan.action: Enable Spring Security default HTTP security headers (X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY) across all REST responses and error handlers.
action_plan.expected_impact: Resolves CWE-693 MIME-sniffing header gap verified by test_baseline_http.py.

action_plan.title: Pin Dockerfile base image digests and add Actuator HEALTHCHECK
action_plan.action: Add `spring-boot-starter-actuator` to `pom.xml`, pin `maven` and `eclipse-temurin` base images with `@sha256` digests in `Dockerfile`, and configure `HEALTHCHECK` against `http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates mutable base-tag drift and enables orchestrator container health probes.
